1309|0624ab70.name: Wynne Larson
1309|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1309|23d8b931.name: Wynne Larson
1309|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|6928abbf.name: Newton Burnside
2456|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5512|54ca4be4.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|54ca4be4.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lass, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5518|741f51fb.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|741f51fb.text: Quid pro quo! I'll teach you what I know, but first I want you to perform a small task...

5566|fb513610.name: Tannysa
5566|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

145-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-complete.text: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.
145-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
146-accept.text:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
146-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

1920-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-complete.text:
Very well done!  I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.

Your value to the society of mages grows, $N.
1920-complete.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-progress.text: Have you captured the creatures, $N?  They must be studied in order to determine the reason behind their arrival.
1920-progress.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1921-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1921-accept.text:
You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe.  Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials  

The robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.

Gather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the $C District.
1921-accept.title: Gathering Materials

1921-complete.name: Wynne Larson
1921-complete.text: Yes, these are great pieces of linen.  I can make a fine robe with them.  And after I weave the rift gems into it, we'll have a garment fit for a $c!
1921-complete.title: Gathering Materials

1921-progress.name: Wynne Larson
1921-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Jennea told me you would come.  Do you have something for me?
1921-progress.title: Gathering Materials

1941-complete.name: Wynne Larson
1941-complete.text: Here is your robe.  It's one of my best made yet!  Wear it with pride, and when people ask... tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!
1941-complete.title: Manaweave Robe
